description: This file defines the 'iron-iconset-svg' web component, which allows users to define and manage custom SVG icon sets. It includes properties for icon set name and size, methods for applying/removing icons, and internal logic for icon management. It also imports relevant Polymer and iron-meta dependencies.

classes.name: iron-iconset-svg
classes.description: A Polymer web component that manages SVG icon sets, allowing icons to be added, retrieved, and applied to elements.

methods.name: getIconNames
methods.description: Returns an array of fully qualified icon names in this iconset.

methods.name: applyIcon
methods.description: Applies a specified icon to a given element by inserting the SVG into the element's DOM.

methods.name: removeIcon
methods.description: Removes a previously applied icon from the specified element.

methods.name: _nameChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when the iconset's name property changes, registering metadata and firing an event.

methods.name: _createIconMap
methods.description: Creates a map of icon IDs to SVG elements within the iconset.

methods.name: _cloneIcon
methods.description: Produces an SVG clone corresponding to a specified icon ID.

methods.name: _prepareSvgClone
methods.description: Prepares and returns a clone of an SVG element with appropriate sizing and attributes.
